computes_nothing: every number is read verbatim from the source JSON; this script only redraws, so the two renderings cannot disagree
scope: FULL DICTIONARY (131,072); panel-width figures dropped per directive
sort: descending |partial rho|; rows without a partial rho last
color_rationale: raw and partialled are one quantity under two conditions -> light/dark of one hue, not two hues; keeps orange/blue free for context-vs-answer elsewhere

rows.label: decoder mass in prefix-covariance top-48 subspace (geometric)
max cosine to another decoder column

caveats: PROVISIONAL target: #1738 SAE->SAE context arm, not the full-width dense->SAE map. Arms rank at rho=0.933 at panel width — shape survives, levels do not.
A single partial rho is not a valid summary for predictors showing effect modification across activity deciles; read rho_by_activity_decile for those.
`activity` has no partialled bar — partialling a variable on itself is undefined.
mean_run_length and template_token_frac are absent pending the pod capture leg.
what_is_plotted: Per continuous predictor, two horizontal bars: raw Spearman rho against per-feature held-out R^2 over the full dictionary, and the same rho partialling out per-answer firing frequency. Whiskers are percentile 95% bootstrap CIs carried verbatim from the source JSON.
